rationale: The description identifies enterprise applications in human-capital, enterprise-resource and financial management. These are stated functional domains of the software, supporting a conventional business-management offering without requiring inference of specific operations.
evidence_spans: human capital management (HCM), enterprise resource management (ERP), and financial management applications
conflict_response: The concern is right that specific operations are not listed, but the description does more than name a vendor: it explicitly says its applications specialize in three management domains. Those conventional functional categories meaningfully describe the offering, so a supported negative is appropriate.
